methodology: Reviewed the actual fixture/action/oracle of every baseline source entry and its present application/database/tool consumer. A current source location or green coverage alone is not a necessity proof.

The case ID identifies the distinct input/outcome partition. Its basis identifies the current function and consumer; the line locates the complete fixture and independent expected values in the prepared source.
Different unit/HTTP/native-database/browser seams remain distinct where they protect different composition, transport, authority, storage or concurrency failure paths.

Completed repair replays, dated hosted/native rollouts, unreachable prototype subjects, duplicate same-seam assertions, bare-unmounted-DOM oracles and tag-only fault fixtures are retired or consolidated. Current old-record operations and real stale-response/abort/navigation guards remain.
This is a source and worksheet necessity assessment, not proof of mathematical minimality or absence of bugs. Independent human review is still required under DoD v2.1.
sourceBodies: Full fixture/input/oracle bodies are in the prepared source at bases[basisIndex].file:preparedSourceLine. Current source metadata and categories are in docs/test-case-inventory.json; full review working records are preserved in the local checkpoint.
